findings.title: Upstream libktx fuzzing and decompression fixes require an adversarial KTX2 ingestion gate

sources.event: reject failed ETC1S palette/table decodes, Oct 16

findings.source_quality: A for merged code and explicit repro descriptions; B for safety coverage extrapolation.
findings.evidence: Maintainers merged checks after libFuzzer detected out-of-bounds data-range/header reads and invalid ETC1S table failure handling; separate fixes correct ZLIB/Zstd size handling and valid-ZLIB streaming false negatives.
findings.contradiction_or_uncertainty: No exploit or CVE has been established. The bug reports concern libktx paths; no evidence that KONA's browser-side KTX2Loader is affected or that libktx runs in the current production pipeline. Latest public tagged release observed: v5.0.0-rc2 (2026-08-17), preceding these fixes.
findings.implication: Before accepting external customer KTX2: sandbox any libktx-based conversion, cap texture/mip/decompressed bytes and time, enforce format/level bounds, and maintain malformed + valid ZLIB/Zstd/BasisLZ/ETC1S fixtures; version-pin converter and test recovery without crashes or hangs.
findings.isolated_experiment: Isolated negative-input KTX2 fixture under existing asset-pipeline experiments; no new top-level experiment
findings.priority_effect: Promote KTX2 intake safety as a release-gate prerequisite for untrusted external assets, not a reason to change the top three research experiments.

findings.title: UASTC quality flag fix invalidates naive compression A/B settings equivalence

sources.event: UASTC quality bit-mask and CLI flag handling correction

findings.source_quality: A for merged implementation and code explanation; B for potential difference in quality metrics.
findings.evidence: KTX_PACK_UASTC_LEVEL_MASK was 0xF, encompassing a non-quality option bit (8), while ktx CLI quality-setting logic altered non-level flag bits. Upstream changes mask to 0x7 and preserves unrelated flags.
findings.contradiction_or_uncertainty: No project-specific encoder invocation or affected legacy output has been demonstrated; not a measured visual-quality gain. Changes are in upstream development, not verified in a tagged release.
findings.implication: For the native Blender KTX2 vs external postprocessing comparison, record exact compressor build, quality level, UASTC options, KTX metadata, bit-for-bit determinism, file size, decoded error, mobile transcode behavior. Avoid mixing before/after tool versions as if encoding parameters were equivalent.
findings.isolated_experiment: One isolated version-pinned encoder A/B fixture inside existing KTX2 comparison; no new top-level experiment
findings.priority_effect: Strengthens comparability gate, no portfolio reprioritization.
